refuse.same-pin: Pick a different pin. A wire needs two ends.
refuse.no-such-pin: {end} is not a pin on this part. The wire was not made.
refuse.mechanical-pin: {end} is a mounting point, not an electrical pin. The wire was not made.
refuse.not-on-view: {part} is not on the board yet. Place it first, then wire it.
refuse.hole-not-on-surface: {hole} is not a hole on this breadboard.
refuse.same-strip: {a} and {b} are already connected inside the breadboard.
refuse.duplicate-wire: {a} and {b} already have a wire between them.
refuse.empty-target: No pin there. The wire was not made.
refuse.quota: This project has reached a size limit ({limit}). Remove something before adding more.
refuse.permission: You are viewing this project. Ask the owner for edit access.
refuse.read-only: This project is open read only, so it cannot be changed here.
